question: How do you run the OpenTelemetry Collector with Docker?
response_text: Run `docker run -p 4317:4317 -p 4318:4318 -v $(pwd)/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml otel/opentelemetry-collector`, mounting your collector config into the container. Use the `-contrib` image variant instead of the core one if your pipeline needs a receiver or exporter — such as the file exporter — that ships only in the contrib distribution.
